{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_df = sales_df[sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the fraction of loyal customers who converted
fraction_converted = loyal_df['converted'].mean()

# Verify the count of loyal customers and conversions
loyal_count = len(loyal_df)
converted_count = loyal_df['converted'].sum()

fraction_converted, loyal_count, converted_count"}
